# idle: settings with nothing to route leave the router alone; a source filled starts sing-box; emptied again it is closed
# (supervisor/transcript_test.go; go test -run TestTranscripts -update ./supervisor/ writes it anew)

== write the settings: a rule whose source is empty
state: none, running false

== Boot
system RestoreDNS -> changed false
system RemoveFirewall
system RemoveRouting
log info: no rule has a server yet: the router is left alone until a source is filled
result ok: no rule has a server yet: the router is left alone until a source is filled
state: released, running false

== write the settings: the source has a SOCKS5 link
state: released, running false

== Apply
system LANAddress -> "192.168.1.1"
system Devices [] -> none
system NTPServerNames -> []
engine Check C1 -> ok
    C1 = inbounds: tproxy-in tproxy 127.0.0.1:1602, dns-in direct 127.0.0.42:53; outbounds: direct-out direct, block block, s5 socks, main-out selector; rule sets: 1
engine ExcludeDownloads []
engine Build C1 -> instance 1
instance 1 OnRuleSetUpdate [main-user-domains-ruleset]
instance 1 Start -> ok
engine Ready -> ok
instance 1 AdoptSelections {main-out=main-out} members {src1=s5}
log info: configuration: rules main (s5); sources s5 (1 links); 1 lists (0 downloaded, 1 from files); DNS udp 127.0.0.1:9; the LAN on
log info: list main-user-domains-ruleset: file $DIR/rulesets/main-user-domains-ruleset.json
system AllowBridgedTraffic -> []
system ApplyRouting ipv6=false -> ok
system RouteUplinks -> []
system UpdateFirewall none to P1 -> ok
    P1 = interfaces br-lan
log info: firewall: 0 address ranges of the lists go to the proxy by address
system TakeOverDNS -> changed true
log info: the DNS of the LAN asks the backend now
dnsmasq Kick after 3s
log info: running, N ms after the start
clock Kick
result ok: started in N ms
state: running, running true

== write the settings: the source empty again
state: running, running true

== Apply
system RestoreDNS -> changed true
log info: the DNS of the LAN is as it was before the backend
dnsmasq Kick after 3s
system RemoveFirewall
system RemoveRouting
instance 1 Close -> ok
log info: no rule has a server yet: the router is left alone until a source is filled
result ok: no rule has a server yet: the router is left alone until a source is filled
state: released, running false

== Stop
system RestoreDNS -> changed false
system RemoveFirewall
system RemoveRouting
state: stopped, running false
